stem: A temperature/RH sensor is exposed to direct radiant heating from a fixture and reports warmer conditions than nearby shielded canopy sensors. What is the best next step?
choices: Use only the hottest reading because extreme values are always most accurate
Ignore all temperature data and control only from RH
Change nutrient strength to correct the sensor
Check placement, shielding, and calibration and compare readings at representative canopy positions
rationale: Environmental sensors should represent the air and location being managed. Radiant heating and placement can bias measurements, so context and calibration must be checked.
